title: Reconcile live progress with durable milestone counts in portfolio Reports
description:
The living optimization Report overlays current assessment progress on the latest immutable milestone, but still renders the milestone summary count. Operators can simultaneously see a current nonzero assessment count and a stale zero count for the same phase.

Feature: One coherent visible progress state

Scenario: Live assessment is ahead of the durable milestone
  Given the latest immutable milestone records zero completed assessments
  And live progress records a later completed count for the same total
  When the Report is rendered
  Then the visible assessment summary uses the newer live count
  And it does not show a contradictory stale count as current status
  And the immutable milestone remains available as evidence

Scenario: A newer durable milestone supersedes live progress
  Given a durable milestone includes completed assessment evidence
  When the Report is rendered
  Then stale or older live progress does not override it.

No client information is included.
